sloka: तेन वध्यो ऽहमाज्ञप्तो रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा ।मत्प्रभावमविज्ञाय रावणेन दुरात्मना ।। ५.५८.१४४ ।।।।
transliteration: tena vadhyo 'hamājñapto rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā ।matprabhāvamavijñāya rāvaṇena durātmanā ।। 5.58.144 ।।।।

translations.english: "The evilminded demon, Ravana, who perpetrates dreadful acts ordered my slaughter, not knowing my power.
